learning_outcomes.text: Understand the basic properties of the Laplace transforms.
Solve Cauchy problems in differential equations using L transform and inverse L transform.
Apply convolution integral transform and transfer function models.
Understand Fourier transform and Bode diagram of the linear model.
Understand the basic properties of the Z transform.
Work with sampled data linear systems and discrete transfer functions.
Solve difference equations using Z transform and inverse Z transform.
Understand the state space notion, state variables, and state trajectory.
Apply introduction methods of state variables and state equations.
Analyze the steady state of the system, static characteristics, and types of singular points.
Understand the characteristic function of the linear dynamic system and the notion of stability.
Apply methods of numerical solution of the state space equation.
Perform sampling time assessment and analyze the stability of numerical methods.
Understand explicit and implicit methods, and predictor-corrector methods.

syllabus_topics: The basic properties of the Laplace transforms
L transform solution of Cauchy problem in differential equations, inverse L transform
Convolution integral transform and transfer function models
Fourier transform, Bode diagram of the linear model
The basic properties of the Z transform
Sampled data linear system, discrete transfer function
Z transform solution of the difference equation, inverse Z transform
The state space notion, state variables, state trajectory
Introduction methods of state variables, state equations
Steady state of the system, static characteristics, types of singular points
Characteristic function of the linear dynamic system, stability notion
Methods of numerical solution of the state space equation
Sampling time assessment, stability of the numerical method
